copy: Your first item is on us
Run one complete AI listing on this device — free, and without an account.

expanded_copy.guided_fix: If the AI reads the item wrong, we'll help you correct it once. A fresh analysis, new photos, or a second item is outside the free allowance.
expanded_copy.recovery: After you get a usable result, your encrypted guest draft and photos stay recoverable for 24 hours. Claim them with an account to keep them; otherwise they're deleted.
